title: Aromatic Charred Ethiopian Lamb Skillet
description: A one-pot Ethiopian dish featuring charred lamb, crunchy vegetables, and a sweet glaze, all made easy with mayonnaise and simple spices.
instructions: Heat a large cast iron skillet over medium high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped bell pepper to the skillet and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
In a small bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, berbere spice, honey, and apple cider vinegar.
Add the cooked lamb back to the skillet and pour the mayonnaise mixture over the top.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the lamb is coated in the glaze and the vegetables are tender.
